title: Refund approval
text: A service manager must approve every refund. Requests above AUD 500 additionally need the operations lead. This version is retired after 5 October 2026.

title: Refund approval
text: A service manager must approve every refund. Requests above AUD 250 additionally need the operations lead. An assistant may prepare a draft but cannot approve or execute a refund.

title: Customer communications
text: Draft responses must cite the ticket and the relevant policy. The assigned human reviews the exact recipient and message before sending. Missing customer details must be requested through the review queue.

title: Service escalation
text: Leo owns service scheduling exceptions. Maya owns the weekly operations report. Technical access problems go to the service desk. Unclear or mixed requests go to review; do not guess the main intent.

title: Refund proposal
text: Discussion draft: consider letting assistants approve small refunds automatically. This draft is not an approved policy.
